_note: Store screenshots per language. tag: the Chrome UI language the popup is captured in. newTab: Chrome's own title for a new tab in that language (the browser frame shows a neutral new tab). copies: locales whose images are copied from another one. Captions are in <locale>.json, keyed by the page in source/ (h = headline, s = subline, c = callouts in the page's order); English is in the HTML.
